notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Orca's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat an arbitarily large number of times.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Orca, adding {C}{C}.
Orca dies, triggering its second ability, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).
